in_sanskrit.name: श्रवणम्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The act of listening or paying attention to something, the sense of hearing, or the deity Shravan, the god of listening.

in_hindi.name: श्रवण
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्रवण (Shravaṇa) is a Sanskrit word that means 'to hear'. It is derived from the root 'shrava' which means 'to hear'. In Hinduism, Shravan is also the name of a god who is believed to be the deity of listening and learning. He is also known as 'Hastapad' or 'Elephant-handed' because of his elephant head.
